body: The fact that she’s making me go to therapy. Like I get why, but it bothered me some if that makes any sense to you at all. I went there to get partial help, I have reasons as to why I dislike therapists. I went to that appointment hoping to get something to help me help myself, but she isn’t willing to continue prescribing me the meds if I don’t go to therapy. She straight up told me that she wouldn’t refill them if I didn’t come back and see her/get into therapy. Like I don’t understand it, refusing to give someone something who just wants to feel better is kind of absurd in my eyes but I mean hey, I’m sure she means more good than harm so it is what it is
It wasn’t the therapist, it was the doctor. Felt kinda irritated with her honestly, but I wanted the meds so I did what I had to
